objects.description: Enumeration of all commands recognized by pspg, covering UI events, theme selection, searching, navigation, copying, marking, and toggles. Values are used to translate input events to actions.
Enumeration of supported clipboard/export formats for copy operations.
Enumeration selecting the copy destination: a file or the system clipboard.
Configuration structure for pspg runtime behavior, UI, formats, clipboard, and connection-related options. Used by save_config/load_config and many runtime features.

functions.name: initialize_special_keycodes
functions.description: Initializes internal mappings for special key codes used by the command translator. Intended to be called during program startup before processing input events. Specific keycode set and side effects are not documented.
requirements: Must be called before functions that depend on special keycode mappings (inferred from name and purpose).
No arguments; no return value; error handling unknown.

functions.name: cmd_string
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for a PspgCommand value. Useful for logging, debugging, or UI display of command names. Behavior for unknown values is not documented.
requirements: cmd must be a valid PspgCommand enum value (inferred).
Returned pointer is const; caller must not modify or free it (inferred from return type).

functions.name: translate_event
functions.signature: int translate_event(int c, bool alt, Options *opts, int *nested_command);
functions.description: Translates a key event (key code c and Alt modifier) into a PspgCommand. Uses Options to honor user configuration (e.g., mouse, theme, toggles). If a command requires a nested/secondary command, nested_command may be used to return it. Exact mapping rules and error codes are not documented.
requirements: c is a key code produced by the input system used by this library (inferred).
alt indicates whether the Alt modifier is active for this event (inferred).
opts must point to a valid, initialized Options struct; must not be NULL (inferred from usage).
If nested_command is non-NULL, it must point to writable int storage to receive a nested command (inferred).
Return value is an int intended to be a PspgCommand; specific sentinel values for errors or ‘no-op’ are unknown.

functions.name: require_complete_load
functions.description: Indicates whether executing the given command requires that data be completely loaded (e.g., some commands might be disabled during progressive loading). Exact rules and which commands require a full load are not documented.
requirements: cmd should be a valid PspgCommand enum value (inferred).
Return true means caller should ensure data is fully loaded before executing the command; precise definition of “complete load” is not specified.

functions.name: is_cmd_RowNumToggle
functions.description: Checks if the given key event (key code c with Alt modifier) corresponds to the RowNum toggle command (cmd_RowNumToggle). Useful for context-sensitive handling before full translation. Mapping details are not documented.
requirements: c is a key code recognized by the input/mapping system (inferred).
alt indicates whether Alt is pressed (inferred).

functions.name: key_is_allowed_mark_mode_cursor
functions.description: Reports whether the given key code is permitted for cursor movement/interaction while in mark mode. Exact allowed keys are not documented.
requirements: c must be a key code recognized by the library (inferred).

functions.name: cmd_get_theme
functions.description: Maps a theme-selection command (e.g., cmd_SetTheme_*) to the corresponding theme identifier (int). Intended to decode theme-setting commands into a numeric theme index. Behavior for non-theme commands is not documented.
requirements: cmd should be one of the cmd_SetTheme_* or related theme commands (inferred).
Return value is an integer theme id; valid range and special values (e.g., -1) are unknown.

functions.name: theme_get_cmd
functions.description: Returns the command id (PspgCommand) that would select the given theme identifier. Intended as the inverse of cmd_get_theme for known themes. Behavior for unknown theme ids is not documented.
requirements: theme must be a valid theme identifier (inferred).
Return value is an int intended to be a PspgCommand; mapping for invalid themes is unknown.

functions.name: save_config
functions.description: Saves the provided Options configuration to the file at path. File format and persistence semantics are not documented. Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: path must be a valid, writable file path string; must not be NULL (inferred).
opts must point to a valid, initialized Options struct; must not be NULL (inferred).
Caller should handle a false return as failure to save and avoid assuming partial writes’ semantics (inferred).

functions.name: load_config
functions.description: Loads configuration from the file at path into the provided Options struct. Returns true on success, false on failure. Exact format and which fields are affected are not documented.
requirements: path must be a valid, readable file path string; must not be NULL (inferred).
opts must point to valid, writable Options storage; must not be NULL (inferred).
On false return, caller must not assume any particular state of opts (e.g., partial population is possible; specifics unknown).
